FINN App (https://www.finn-app.com/) | Product Managers | REMOTE | Full-time

Founded in 2022, we are a fintech company that gives full-time employees fair access to their earned wages, alongside financial services & tools to help them earn and save more. Already active in four countries, we’re expanding rapidly across both product scope and markets. We are a small global remote team. The roles below are applicable to those in the GMT+8 to GMT+8 timezones.

- Sn. Product Manager, Earned Wage Access

- Sn. Product Manager, Onboarding & Activation

Apply: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/finnapp
